scheme_name: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Etc. Candidates
other_conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Caste, Denotified Nomadic, Semi Nomadic Tribe, Landless Agricultural Labourer, or Traditional Artisan.
Must have admission or an unconditional offer for a Master's or Ph.D. programme at a foreign university accredited by the host country's government/authorized body.
Must have secured at least 60% marks (or equivalent grade) in the qualifying examination (Bachelor’s degree for Master’s programmes, Master’s degree for Ph.D. programmes).
Family’s total annual income must be less than or equal to ₹8 lakh per annum.
Two or more siblings of the applicant must not already be availing this scholarship.
For candidates who completed a Bachelor of Engineering after a Diploma (lateral entry), the percentage of marks obtained in the Bachelor’s degree will be considered.
benefits_summary: Provides annual maintenance, contingency, tuition, visa, medical insurance, equipment allowance and airfare reimbursements for studying abroad.
